messages:
ana.prod: Need a tight GA decision: how strict should our preemption model be for reserved pools? exec wants a single recommended default. quick opinions please.
kevin.eng: My vote: graded preemption (soft -> hard). soft = queue short jobs (<=45s) then taper prewarms, hard = preempt after grace window. avoids sudden 503s.
lucy.infra: Ops note: graded preemption requires admission priorities and deterministic quotas per AZ. suggest default AZ cap 85% reserved and regional cap 30% headroom.
omar.sales: Customers care about predictability. some enterprise pilots demand hard isolation (no preempt). we'll gate that behind contract flag `isolation_strict`.
sophie.se: SE ask: surface preemption mode in console and an API flag per-tenant. also show recent preempt events with reason codes.
billing-bot: Billing implication: preempted work should not be charged as burst if it never served tokens. we need clear metric names: dedicated.preempt.count, dedicated.preempted_tokens, dedicated.burst.tokens_used.
kana.prod: Proposed GA defaults: 1) preemption = graded (queue<=45s -> taper prewarm -> preempt after 60s); 2) isolation_strict available as enterprise contract opt-in; 3) headroom default 15% with small-pool clamp floor=1 GPU; 4) AZ/regional caps enforced. Are we comfortable?
kevin.eng: Implementation detail: taper steps = 1 instance per 60s until floor = max(1, floor(pool_gpus*0.05)). add metric prewarm.taper.steps.
lucy.infra: We'll add admission control to prevent a single AZ from exceeding 85% reserved. Also add cross-region fallback flag per tenant (default allow).
omar.sales: For pilots: we can enable isolation_strict for two customers if finance agrees on uplift. need pricing suggestion.
sophie.se: UX will show "preemption mode" and a live meter for burst balance + last preemption events. will push mock by Thu.
billing-bot: Finance will map metrics to SKUs once eng provides expected token counts from canary. propose carryover_off by default; carryover_paid opt-in.
nana.prod: Action items:
- kevin.eng: run canary for graded preemption + simulate taper numbers. due Wed EOD (1769653400).
- lucy.infra: capacity sims us-west/eu-west with AZ/regional caps. due Wed noon.
- sophie.se: console mock + preemption event list. due Thu EOD.
- omar.sales: gather pilot interest for isolation_strict & carryover. due Thu.
- billing-bot/finance: await simulation numbers for pricing.
kevin.eng: TL;DR: graded preemption default + enterprise isolation opt-in. If canary looks bad on tail latencies, fallback to stricter conservative autoscale.
nana.prod: OK locking graded preemption as recommended GA stance and isolation_strict as paywalled opt-in. will add to roadmap doc and call out caveats. thanks :thumbsup:
__notes: single slack thread; messages concatenated in chronological order as required by agents.md
